refactor(globals): reduce cyclomatic complexity of split_esc
refactor: update step callback methods to support asynchronous invocation
Refactor: Make `DummyLM` and callbacks depend on `BaseLM` instead of `LM`
refactor(memory): convert memory classes to serializable

Refactor CLI surfaces around launchers and managed Claude

selection.candidate_order: merged_at ascending within repository, then round-robin by repository rank
selection.github_transport_retry: five attempts for URL/timeout failures with 1,2,4,8 second backoff

prior_corpus_exclusion.rule: exclude every repository named by a prior corpus before eligibility

selection.pull_request_rule: first 100 GitHub results merged 2026-02-17..2026-08-31, sorted by updated ascending; exact case-insensitive bug label or title beginning fix/fixed/fixes/fixing
selection.question: How often does the engine speak when the change declares it changed nothing?

selection.subject_meaning: buggy_sha is the revision before the change and fix_sha the merge commit, keeping the corpus schema stable. Neither names a bug here: the subject declares itself behaviour-preserving, so evidence of a flip is a candidate false conviction rather than a find.
